lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Inter-spot distance increases toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: At least six vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with larger circular blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 5-8 small, high-luminance blobs are visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, distributed sporadically across its surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two symbiotic organisms (remoras) attached or swimming in close proximity to the pectoral and ventral-caudal regions.
